description: Machine-readable AlembicDashboard light conventions contract (P2 AD3, scaled-down Core CO2 pattern). Codifies the AS-IS src/ cross-area runtime import graph derived on 2026-06-12 via scripts/lint-layer-contract.mjs --report at baseline f5ccb9d (25 runtime edges, 18 type-only bridges over 14 areas) — the contract records reality; redesigns go through controller-decided waves. Enforced by scripts/lint-layer-contract.mjs as a blocking step in npm run check. Areas are the real census: each top-level src/ directory plus each top-level src/*.ts(x) module (named by file stem). Imports resolve through relative specifiers only (no path aliases exist); package imports are the AD1 space-boundary gate's jurisdiction.
typeOnlyNote: import type / export type imports are type bridges and do not create runtime coupling; runtime imports must follow allowedRuntimeImports. Observed bridges include utils -> api (problem-projection types) and types -> generated (wire-contract aliases).
layerRationale: main is the composition entry: it mounts App inside the i18n and theme providers and imports nothing else.
App is the root view orchestrator: it consumes components, hooks, api, and the shared leaves; nothing imports App except main.
components (views) consume state/services below them (api, hooks, RuntimeDiagnosticsPanelModel, i18n, theme, constants, lib, utils, types); nothing imports components except App.
api owns HTTP transport plus the normalizer seam and is the only runtime consumer of generated; views never import generated directly.

Leaves import nothing at runtime: types, generated, constants, lib, utils, theme, KnowledgePayload, RuntimeDiagnosticsPanelModel (the latter two are single-module builder/view-model areas consumed from above).

i18n runtime-imports api since W7-c: the language-preference round-trips (/ai/lang) go through the shared HTTP transport (api.getLang/setLang). The edge is one-way — api never imports i18n — so the graph stays a DAG.
normalizerSeam: Cross-provider response variance is absorbed only in api.ts explicit adapters/normalizers (and the utils/error helpers they delegate to): normalizers absorb runtime nulls and shape variance, never contract drift — contract drift is the generated-artifact drift gate's job. UI components consume normalized projections via api/types and must not guess raw payload fields; structurally enforced by this matrix (only api may runtime-import generated; components reach data through api).
charterCrossCheck: AD2 charter (zero-dependency UI consumer of the HTTP contract via generated types; projection only, no business logic): the observed matrix matches — api is the single transport/normalization owner, generated is a leaf consumed only by api (runtime) and types (type bridges), views are projection layers on top. No contradiction found 2026-06-12.
exactEdgeExceptionsContract: Each entry requires {fromFile, toArea, owner, reason, cleanupTrigger}; entries missing any field do not bless an edge. Empty today — the observed runtime graph is a clean downward DAG with no inversions.
cycleFindingsNote: No runtime area cycles observed at baseline f5ccb9d; if one appears it is recorded here with a blessed minority side and an owned cleanup trigger, never silently refactored (AD3 stop clause).
